rationale: The inspected study reports a small positive association between its neuron-coverage measure and steering-angle deviation, declines to claim causation, and calls for more work on whether coverage is a consistent indicator. The claim is narrower than a safety conclusion and blocks use of activation coverage as a composite safety score.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-007-R1, Toohey, Raunak and Binkley, correlation and threats-to-validity discussion, PDF pp. 7-8
S-EVID-007-R2, Toohey, Raunak and Binkley, conclusion, PDF p. 8
limitations: The study used one DNN, transformed images, and a steering-angle-deviation proxy, without a safety-failure threshold.
It shows no predictive value across releases, ODD partitions, sensing modalities, or airborne DAA hazards.
